notes.title: Flutter Away is taking part in the Cozy Job Simulators event! 🎉
notes.notes: [p]This event is a celebration of cozy, wholesome, and family-friendly job simulator games, and is your chance to find some amazing games for your Steam library! From a restaurant owner all the way to a researcher in the Amazon Rainforest, they have it all. So, don’t forget to go and check it out! 💖[url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45686865/sale/CozyJobSimulators"]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45686865/sale/CozyJobSimulators[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Want to know what makes Flutter Away unique as a Cozy Job Sim? We have a full-time nature researcher working at our studio! That’s why the game is filled with authentic discoveries![/p][p]For example, here’s a fun fact we’ve shared before about capybara feet 📔[/p][list][*][p]Capybaras have 4 toes in front, and 3 in the back.[/p][/*][*][p]The webbing between their toes helps them swim, but also spreads their weight over the mud. This lets them run faster when the ground is slick or especially squishy.[/p][/*][*][p]Capybaras don’t have backward knees! The first joint up from their toes is an ankle, which also means… capybaras walk on their tippy-toes like ballerinas![/p][/*][/list][p]Details like this are sprinkled throughout the game ✨[/p][p]We hope you all enjoy exploring nature in Flutter Away with a butterfly researcher’s perspective, and learning about the Amazon Rainforest’s creatures and plants![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/51133d250ecf4357395a3659023717fbdfcb2ce7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Flutter Away Team 🦋[/p]

notes.title: Back to School Games Celebration 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! 🦋[/p][p][/p][p]Flutter Away is participating in the [b]Back to School Games Celebration 2025[/b]! This event celebrates the start of the school year with educational games designed to enhance learning and productivity.[/p][p]We’re featured in the [b]Environment and Nature[/b] section of this event, alongside other great games that highlight environmental education, ecology, conservation, and sustainable living 🌱[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44695353/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44695353/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t had a chance to try it yet, our demo is available for you to play! Here are some [b]tips to help you get the most out of your first day of exploring the Amazon.[/b]💚[/p][p]Flutter Away is a game about exploration.[/p][list][*][p]All animals and plants in the game are based on real-life species found in the Amazon Rainforest![/p][/*][*][p]There’s no combat, enemies, or time limit, so take your time to explore every nook and cranny to get the most out of your experience! [/p][/*][*][p]Don’t forget to take pictures of everything 📸 You may even stumble across hidden discoveries.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3][i][b]~ SPOILERS AHEAD~ [/b][/i][/h3][p]Here are a few of the animals and plants we’d love you to discover in the demo. After playing, be sure to check them out and learn more about the wonders of the Amazon rainforest 💖[/p][p][/p][p][spoiler][b]Capybara [/b][/spoiler]
[spoiler]Capybaras are one of the chillest animals in the Amazon, but like all wildlife, they should be treated with care. Trust takes time, don’t worry if the Capybara runs away from you on Day 1! <3  [/spoiler][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/8be6ded38c90746ae92d6a60b05c160be6514ceb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
[spoiler][b]Kapok Tree[/b][/spoiler]
[spoiler] Every individual adds to the forest - a fact best embodied by the mighty Kapok Trees that fill the Amazon forest. Kapok trees are recognisable by their broad root base and towering branches. They stand tall above the canopy and offer homes to countless creatures large and small. [/spoiler]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/f8ab2d61a365ab3e2805279a398a8245c3810fd9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b][spoiler]Dazzling Nightfigher[/spoiler][/b][/p][p][spoiler]A butterfly that prefers the night? This is a butterfly species that goes against the norms! These playful and energetic creatures are active during the nighttime, a behavior we normally associate with moths. [/spoiler] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/2b274a039054b8e43a04117aea48ca901104b612.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p][spoiler][b]Bromeliads[/b][/spoiler][/p][p][spoiler]Familiar plants from far away. This flower may seem familiar to you, and that's because they are often sold as house plants in garden centres all over the world![/spoiler] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/4946fc859a993c26e731776ddbff6de9db179510.jpg"][/img][spoiler]Did you know that the bright colors are not a flower, but are actually special leaves? They lead to pools of water, sometimes used by tree frogs! 🐸 [/spoiler]  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][spoiler][b]Tracks and feathers[/b][/spoiler][/p][p][spoiler]We don’t always see animals around us. Tracks, sounds, and feathers give clues of what we cannot see. Take some time to notice these small changes as you play, and enjoy the secret signs that life leaves behind![/spoiler] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/41fb7c7754f9a1a4a6cf8c03358240f5b1d33f38.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/75656d5d63f83f3e700206611150601a1766bd06.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][b]And this isn’t everything you can find![/b] Try to take as many photos as you can to discover and learn about all the wildlife in this slice of the Amazon you’ve found yourself in.[/p][p]We hope you’ll enjoy discovering the treasures of the Amazon rainforest in our demo, as well as all the amazing games participating in the Back to School Games Celebration![/p][p][/p][p]Flutter Away Team 🦋[/p]

notes.title: Capybara have… different toes?
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Aditia here, the Community Manager at Runaway Play! Recently our Producer Yuko was telling me about how Capybara have… different toes? Did you know about this? I knew the footprints in our game reflected a Capybara’s actual footprint, but I’d never really thought about the ins and outs of their toes and how they walk.. 

Let me hand it over to Jonas, our Nature Researcher and Capybara expert at Runaway to chat more about them, as this topic has garnered interest from a streamer of the game.  

Hi everyone! I’m Jonas and it’s my pleasure to share just a few more facts I found while researching Capybara:
[olist]
[*] Capybara have 4 toes in front, and 3 in the back. I couldn’t figure out why exactly, but I did learn that guinea pigs are their close relatives, and they also have four in front and three in back!
[*] The webbing between their toes helps them swim, but also spreads their weight over mud. This lets them run faster when the ground is slick or especially squishy.
[*] Capybara don’t have backwards knees! The first joint up from their toes is an ankle, which also means… Capybara walk on their tippy toes like ballerinas! A longer foot gives extra spring, and a lot of other animals walk on their tippy toes too, including dogs, cats, birds, and horses.[/olist]And on that note, I hope you all have dancing ballerina Capybara dreams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/3e6c512b2a6db51f32ba2b82e1d063af9e6fdcf6.png[/img]

🦋 Jonas, Aditia & The Flutter Away Team

Hello! 💖 We’re getting increasingly close to launch, and everything is happening so fast! I hope you’ve been keeping cool in the Northern Hemisphere, and cozy if you’re in the Southern Hemisphere, like us.  

Right now we’re incredibly close to 1K followers on Steam, it’s very exciting - we can’t believe so many of you are interested in keeping up with us about our wee game! 🐸

I wanted to pop by and let you know that we’re planning something BIG to celebrate reaching 1K followers here. So, if you’re reading this and you haven’t already given our page on here a follow, then gooo do ittt! :~) 

You can do so by clicking the ‘follow’ button on the main store page, it’s next to the wishlist button!

That’s all for now… Looking forward to revealing the BIG celebration soon! 🎉

notes.title: Extended Demo - Available to play now!✨
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋

We have just dropped a new extended demo as part of Steam Next Fest (June 19 - 26)! You can now enjoy Day 1: daytime and nighttime in Flutter Away!  ☀️🌙 

Not only is this demo longer, but it is also localized! You can now play in French, Italian, German, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese and Korean! 

This demo is only available during Steam Next Fest, so be sure to check it out while you can! 
Below we have some tips so you can get the most out of it! We’ve included some things to keep an eye out for. Can you find them all? 👀

[b]Tips for enjoying the demo: [/b]

Flutter Away is a game about exploration. There’s no combat, enemies, or time limit - so take your time to explore every nook and cranny to get the most out of your experience! We intentionally designed this game to encourage you to slow down, so don’t rush!  You could miss the finer details. 

Don’t forget to take pictures of everything! You might even find some hidden discoveries. 👀



[b]Things to look out for: [i]Spoilers ahead![/i] [/b]


[spoiler][b]Dazzling Nightfigher: [/b][/spoiler]A butterfly that prefers the night? 
[spoiler]This is a butterfly species that goes against the norms! These playful and energetic creatures are active during the nighttime, a behavior we normally associate with moths. [/spoiler]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/2b274a039054b8e43a04117aea48ca901104b612.jpg[/img]

[spoiler][b]Bromeliads:[/b][/spoiler] Familiar plants from far away.
[spoiler]This flower may seem familiar to you, and that's because they are often sold as house plants in garden centres all over the world![/spoiler]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/4946fc859a993c26e731776ddbff6de9db179510.jpg[/img]
[spoiler]Did you know that the bright colors are not a flower, but are actually special leaves? They lead to pools of water sometimes used by tree frogs! 🐸 [/spoiler]


[spoiler][b]Tracks and feathers: [/b][/spoiler]We don’t always see animals around us.
[spoiler]Tracks, sounds, and feathers give clues of what we cannot see. Take some time to notice these small changes as you play, and enjoy the secret signs that life leaves behind![/spoiler]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/41fb7c7754f9a1a4a6cf8c03358240f5b1d33f38.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/75656d5d63f83f3e700206611150601a1766bd06.jpg[/img]

[spoiler][b]Glowing mushroom:[/b][/spoiler]  Some forests have night lights.
[spoiler]Glowing mushrooms shine for moths, flies, and beetles who’ll help carry their spores across the forest. When the sun sets, you’ll be invited into the night by the natural glow of fungi and fireflies. [/spoiler]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/85619e40e56377c2b4ef482a85a99beb49998b84.jpg[/img]

[spoiler][b]Walking Palm: [/b][/spoiler] A walking tree?
[spoiler]Seasonal flooding in the Amazon has caused the Walking Palm to stand on roots that can quickly be regrown when the tree falls over. Keep an eye out for these and other quirky plants in your exploration of the Amazon rainforest! [/spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/f4129e4ff7ff582eeb0d525bc135408016ecb4c9.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy this short snippet of Flutter Away! Oh, and if you enjoy the demo and are looking forward to the game don’t forget to add us to your wishlist - it really helps small indie developers like us with visibility on Steam! 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2224030/Flutter_Away/

🦋Libby and the Flutter Away Team

notes.title: Indie Live Expo and Wholesome Direct 2023!!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I hope you’re doing well and keeping cozy! :) 

We’ve been busy working on some top secret things for Flutter Away, many of which we can’t reveal just yet... However, something we CAN share is that Flutter Away has been selected to be a part of Indie Live Expo 2023 and Wholesome Direct 2023!! 🎉💖 


[b]Indie Live Expo[/b] is an annual event that highlights 300+ upcoming indie games with the ‘hottest indie game news’! It’s broadcasted in 3 different languages - Japanese, Chinese and English and consists of a livestream event where hosts provide commentary about the games being featured. This is our first time being a part of this Japanese-led event, and we’re very much looking forward to it! 

You can catch the livestream on Youtube, it’ll begin at our local time 20 May 10 pm NZT, 3 am PT, 6 am ET: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pq98_h4V3_s]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pq98_h4V3_s[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/ffe6cce67219c12e75cf4d8182a13c891d417ab3.png[/img]


[b]Wholesome Direct 2023[/b] is happening on June 10 at 9 am PT, 12 pm ET… which is June 11 at 4 am in our local timezone NZT! 🙈 Catch the future of cozy and uplifting gaming with an hour of exclusive footage and announcements from 70+ indie games, including Flutter Away! (We’re so excited for this, it’s one of the events we always look forward to in a year!!) For more info visit [url=www.wholesomegames.com]www.wholesomegames.com[/url]! 🌼💕


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/fa4d330b038f02998c71128237ea0e6b91ab96b0.gif[/img]


As a small team from all the way in New Zealand, being part of events like this is a huge deal for us and we can’t believe that our short exploration game will be included alongside a lineup of some amazing games. We’re so grateful to have been selected and can’t wait for you to see what we’ll be sharing during these events! <3 


🦋 Aditia and the Flutter Away Team

notes.title: We've released a short demo!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hi everyone! 💖[/b][/h2]
We’re so excited to release a short demo of Flutter Away as a part of the Women-led Games event! 

Grab yourself a warm drink, sit down, get comfortable and delve into a cozy nook of the Amazon rainforest in a short snippet of our game.

Here are some tips for getting more out of the demo, and some things to look out for! 

[h3][b]Tips for enjoying our short demo 🏕[/b][/h3]
Flutter Away is a game about exploration. There is no combat, no enemies, just you and a forest full of wonders to discover. The game is designed intentionally to encourage you to slow down, take a step back and observe the world around you. This means if you rush through the gameplay, you run the risk of missing things.

We encourage you to take your time to explore the environment, look through nooks and crannies and see what you can spot! The more care you take while looking around, the more the game will reward you. 

Don’t forget to snap a picture of what you find! 📸

[h3][b]Things to look out for 🔎[/b][/h3]
We wanted the nature in the game to closely reflect species you can find in the real world. Our Nature Researcher Jonas highlighted a few real life species you may spot while playing the demo! 


[h3][b][i]~ WARNING SPOILERS AHEAD~ [/i][/b][/h3]


[b][spoiler]Blue Morpho (Morpho peleides)  [/spoiler][/b]
[spoiler]Blue Morphos are kept in butterfly gardens around the world. Despite their fame, they’re often misinterpreted online with the blue appearing on both sides of their wings. Their true colors are far more intricate. [/spoiler]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/b6ae6ad6f026ae6469cdb85a7e5262df711d6310.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/b6ae6ad6f026ae6469cdb85a7e5262df711d6310.gif[/img][/url]

[b][spoiler]Dido Longwing (Philaethria dido) [/spoiler][/b]
[spoiler]The Dido Longwing is one of the more energetic butterflies to exist! Take time to compare Dido’s fluttery exuberance to mellower Blue Morphos. [/spoiler]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/81cc5d63d8003671e90f345eaa2669b8137861bd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/81cc5d63d8003671e90f345eaa2669b8137861bd.gif[/img][/url]

[b][spoiler]Red Passion Flower (Passiflora racemosa)  [/spoiler][/b]
[spoiler]Passion Flowers are a vine that grows through the branches of the Amazon rainforest. They are also food for many butterflies, caterpillars, and other Amazonian animals. [/spoiler]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/acd0754ff1d32018065b7d6c18ae46d13caa2d31.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/acd0754ff1d32018065b7d6c18ae46d13caa2d31.gif[/img][/url]

[b][spoiler]Capybara (Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris) [/spoiler][/b]
[spoiler]Capybaras are one of the chillest animals in the Amazon, but like all wildlife, they should be treated with care. Trust takes time, don’t worry if the Capybara runs away from you on Day 1! <3  [/spoiler]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/8be6ded38c90746ae92d6a60b05c160be6514ceb.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/8be6ded38c90746ae92d6a60b05c160be6514ceb.gif[/img][/url]

[b][spoiler]Kapok Tree (Ceiba pentandra)  [/spoiler][/b]
[spoiler] Every individual adds to the forest - a fact best embodied by the mighty Kapok Trees that fill the Amazon forest. Kapok trees are recognisable by their broad root base and towering branches. They stand tall above the canopy and offer homes to countless creatures large and small. [/spoiler]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/f8ab2d61a365ab3e2805279a398a8245c3810fd9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495609/f8ab2d61a365ab3e2805279a398a8245c3810fd9.gif[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy this short snippet of Flutter Away! Please leave us a review with your thoughts and don’t forget to wishlist the game! 💖 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2224030/Flutter_Away/

🦋 Aditia and the Flutter Away Team
